## ResearchCategories

```java
public class ResearchCategories
```

The original TC4 research registry.

The native port publishes the original corpus through `ResearchCatalog`; this class is the public view of it and keeps the original registration methods, so an add-on may still add its own research.

<a id="researchcategories-researchcategories"></a>
```java
public static LinkedHashMap<String, ResearchCategoryList> researchCategories
```

The original public map; it stays mutable so an add-on may add a category or a research entry.

<a id="researchcategories-loadnative"></a>
```java
public static void loadNative()
```

Publishes the original corpus into the public map. Repeated calls do nothing.

<a id="researchcategories-getresearchlist"></a>
```java
public static ResearchCategoryList getResearchList(String key)
```

Initializes the global native corpus then returns the live category, or null for an absent key (including null unless manually registered).

<a id="researchcategories-getcategoryname"></a>
```java
public static String getCategoryName(String key)
```

The original translated category name.

<a id="researchcategories-getresearch"></a>
```java
public static ResearchItem getResearch(String key)
```

Initializes the global native corpus and returns the first live matching entry, or null for null/absent keys in ordinary registrations.

<a id="researchcategories-allresearch"></a>
```java
public static Collection<ResearchItem> allResearch()
```

Every research entry of the public registry.

<a id="researchcategories-registercategory"></a>
```java
public static void registerCategory(String key, ResourceLocation icon, ResourceLocation background)
```

Initializes native research then registers a category only if absent, retaining nullable key/icon/background without copying or validation.

An add-on category gets its own tab in the Thaumonomicon after the six original ones, in registration order, as in the original. `icon` is drawn over the whole 16x16 tab icon whatever its pixel size; `background` is the scrolling map sheet, read with the geometry of the original 512x512 sheet (`thaumcraft:textures/gui/gui_researchback.png`). The tab tooltip is the translation of `tc.research_category.<key>`.

<a id="researchcategories-categorykeys"></a>
```java
public static java.util.List<String> categoryKeys()
```

The keys of every category, the six original ones first, then add-on categories in registration order.

<a id="researchcategories-addresearch"></a>
```java
public static void addResearch(ResearchItem ri)
```

The original registration: a cell may only be used once, unless the research is virtual.

An add-on entry registered here is research of the game, not only of this map: the Thaumonomicon, the research table, the purchase of secondary research, scan clues (`setItemTriggers`, `setEntityTriggers`, `setAspectTriggers`), completion and sync read it. Its name and text are the translations of `tc.research_name.<key>` and `tc.research_text.<key>`; its page texts are translation keys. Register on both sides during mod initialization, like the original, so a client and its server know the same keys.

## ResearchCategory

```java
public class ResearchCategory extends ResearchCategoryList
```

A research category with the original knowledge formula.

The formula is a weighted aspect list: every aspect of the formula multiplies the amount the player holds of that aspect, and the square root of the total is the knowledge the category reports.

```java
public ResourceLocation background2
public String researchKey
public String key
public AspectList formula
public ResearchCategory(String key, String researchKey, AspectList formula, ResourceLocation icon, ResourceLocation background)
public ResearchCategory(String key, String researchKey, AspectList formula, ResourceLocation icon, ResourceLocation background, ResourceLocation background2)
```

<a id="researchcategory-applyformula"></a>
```java
public int applyFormula(AspectList input)
```

The original formula: the weighted total, square rooted and rounded up.

<a id="researchcategory-applyformula-2"></a>
```java
public int applyFormula(AspectList input, double multiplier)
```

Returns ceil(sqrt(weighted aspect-unit total)) for positive totals, applying multiplier squared; null formula/input returns zero without mutation.

## ResearchEntry

```java
public class ResearchEntry
```

The legacy research entry view: the public shape an add-on may read for one research key.

The native port keeps the original corpus in `ResearchItem`; of copies scalar values, aliases parent/sibling arrays and icon stacks, and setters do not write back to the ResearchItem. Stages/addenda/rewards are TC6-style DTO storage, not the TC4 1.7.10 progression model; in 1.21.1 use ResearchItem registration with supported pages/triggers for gameplay progression.


<a id="researchpage-researchpage-11"></a>
```java
public ResearchPage(ItemStack input)
```

The original smelting page: the furnace input and its result. In 1.7.10 the global furnace registry resolved the output here; 1.21.1 keeps smelting recipes per world, so recipeOutput stays null and the book resolves the result in the recipe manager of the client world when the page is drawn. Use `ResearchPage(ItemStack, Level)` when the output is needed on the server.


Stores the nullable input by reference and copies the live smelting output when resolvable; null/empty input, null level, no server or no recipe leaves recipeOutput null, without consuming input.

```java
public ResearchPage(InfusionRecipe recipe)
```

Retains an infusion recipe and its stack output (or central input for patches) by reference; null recipe throws NPE, without registration.

```java
public ResearchPage(InfusionEnchantmentRecipe recipe)
```

Creates an enchantment infusion page retaining the nullable recipe reference; output stays null, with no registration.

<a id="researchpage-researchpage-15"></a>
```java
public ResearchPage(ResourceLocation image, String caption)
```

Creates an image page retaining nullable texture/caption references without loading an image or changing research.

<a id="researchpage-researchpage-16"></a>
```java
public ResearchPage(AspectList as)
```

Creates an aspect page retaining the nullable aspect-unit list by reference; does not spend aspects or register research.

<a id="researchpage-recipe"></a>
```java
public static ResearchPage recipe(ResourceLocation... ids)
```

A page that shows the 1.21.1 recipes with these ids: crafting, arcane, crucible, infusion or enchantment infusion recipes, data-driven or not. This is the native way to show an add-on's JSON recipes; the recipe objects of the original constructors still work for recipes registered through `ThaumcraftApi`. The ids are resolved in the recipe manager of the client world when the page is drawn; a page none of whose ids resolves is not shown. Not a 1.7.10 constructor.

<a id="researchpage-corpuspage"></a>
```java
public thaumcraft.common.lib.research.ResearchDefinition.Page corpusPage()
```

The corpus page this object is the public view of, or null for a page an add-on made.

<a id="researchpage-of"></a>
```java
public static ResearchPage of(thaumcraft.common.lib.research.ResearchDefinition.Page page)
```

The native corpus page behind this view.

<a id="researchpage-legacytype"></a>
```java
public static PageType legacyType(String expression)
```

The original page kind of a retained corpus expression.

The eight expressions of the corpus are the original array and smelting pages: `oracle thaumcraft/common/config/ConfigResearch.java:199` (BANNERS, an arcane recipe array), `:374` (ORE, a normal recipe array) and the crucible, the jar label, the primal arrow, the runic augmentation and the sceptre pages. The original built them from the recipe arrays, so the kind of the page follows the kind of the array.


The original translated text; an unknown key falls back to the raw text.

## ScanResult

```java
public class ScanResult
```

Original callback DTO; numeric item IDs are current native registry IDs, never old-world import IDs. In 1.7.10 id/meta identified an item/subtype; in 1.21.1 meta is damage in points and IDs are runtime-only. Use `item(ItemStack)` and its stack witness; use nodePosition/nodeDimension for nodes. Never persist numeric IDs across registry changes.

```java
public byte type
public int id
public int meta
public Entity entity
public String phenomena
```

<a id="scanresult-stack"></a>
```java
public ItemStack stack
```

Native flattened item witness, used in preference to the legacy-shaped id/meta fields.

<a id="scanresult-nodeposition"></a>

## ScanningManager

```java
public class ScanningManager
```

> **Deprecated.**

The registry of scannable things.

The native port keeps the original registration order: the first registered handler that accepts the scanned target wins when find is explicitly called; the native thaumometer never calls this registry.

This is a later compatibility shape, not a TC4 1.7.10 generic target-dispatch service. In 1.21.1 registrations only populate isolated data, not gameplay scan callbacks.

**Deprecated:** Use ThaumcraftApi.registerScanEventhandler for phenomena callbacks; no equivalent generic-target dispatcher is currently wired into native gameplay.
